name: Teen Leadership Program
what_you_do: Teens work with museum guests in the exhibits and labs while getting mentorship and daily learning. It builds career skills and shows how the museum runs.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18, or at least a rising sophomore. Must attend the initial training and commit to 8 shifts over 16 weeks.
duration: 8 shifts over 16 weeks, every other weekend (Saturday or Sunday)
deadline_text: Spring semester applications open Sunday, November 8. Close date not posted. The Fall 2026 round is closed.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the museum's volunteer page. It is hard to get in. They look at writing, drive, growth and teamwork.
notes: The page labels these as 2027 spring applications, but its weekday and date pairs (Sunday, Nov 8 and Saturday, Jan 10) match 2026. Confirm the dates with the museum.
